apple-airpods-4-with-active-noise-cancel: Very comfortable and convenient; noise cancelling isn't perfect.
apple-airpods-pro-2: Easy everyday earbuds with a good mic; they slip out in workouts.
apple-airpods-pro-3: Secure fit for many; others feel pressure or prefer the Pro 2 sound.
bose-quietcomfort-ultra-earbuds-2nd-gen: Noise cancelling most rate the best they've used; a few had ear pain.
bowers-wilkins-pi8: Clear, spacious sound; a few report connection or charging issues.
dunu-kima-2: Warm-neutral with standout vocals; the flat shells don't fit all.
focal-bathys-mg: Detailed, spacious wireless sound; noise cancelling is just good.
hifiman-arya-organic: Big soundstage at a fair price; the bright treble tires some.
hifiman-arya-stealth: Huge soundstage and imaging; several drivers failed.
hifiman-edition-xs: Outstanding value with a wide stage; build quality is the gripe.
hifiman-sundara: Detailed, balanced step up; many report dead or buzzing drivers.
kiwi-ears-astral: Clean, sharp imaging for gaming; the large shell hurts some ears.
kz-duonic: Very cheap with crisp detail; the bass is lighter than promised.
kz-prx: A cheap way into planar sound; it's hard to drive without a DAC.
letshuoer-astralis: Warm, fun planar with strong bass; less technical than rivals.
letshuoer-s12-pro: Clear, energetic sound; the short, angled nozzle is hard to seal.
letshuoer-s12-ultra: Fast bass and smooth treble in a small shell; modest soundstage.
meze-109-pro: Warm, punchy and comfortable; the treble is a bit sharp for some.
meze-alba: Tiny and easy to wear for hours; thin or bass-light for some.
moondrop-old-fashioned: Very cheap, light and open-sounding; thin bass that needs EQ.
moondrop-space-travel-2: Likeable sound at low cost; some report fit or battery problems.
sennheiser-hd-600: Natural, smooth mids people keep for years; the clamp is strong.
sennheiser-hd-650: Warm, smooth mids kept for years; dull or veiled for a few.
sennheiser-hd-800-s: Expansive stage and long-session comfort; the bass is thin.
sennheiser-momentum-true-wireless-5: Sound and noise cancelling several prefer to the AirPods Pro 3.
simgot-ew300: Detailed, comfortable and cheap with nozzles; sharp treble for some.
sony-linkbuds-s: Light, well built, decent noise cancelling; a few battery faults.
sony-wf-1000xm6: Top noise cancelling and long battery; the fit is a snag for some.
thieaudio-monarch-mkiv: Clean, detailed and wide with strong bass; the big shells hurt.
